verdict.rationale: Together AI is an API-first platform. Its docs cover an OpenAI-compatible inference API that needs only an API key and base URL change, and one API for chat, image, audio and embeddings. The API also handles batch jobs and function calling, and fine-tuning jobs can be launched via the API, SDK or CLI. The official TypeScript library wraps the Together REST API, and a community user independently confirms using the Python API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, since probes at all candidate paths returned 404.
